name: Kubota Asahi
source:
She is beautiful and has excellent grades. She is a talented girl who is well-known at school. Although she is out of reach, she has a bright and friendly personality and many friends. She became the student council president so that everyone at school could have a good time.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200221221523/http://crossover-game.jp/include/saiminiincho/character.html?20160527]official website[/url]]
